parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Find a comfortable place to rest tonight. <short pause> Let your body settle into stillness. <short pause> Notice your breath... moving in, and out, without effort.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Each breath you take is a gift. <short pause> You do not make the air. You do not create the rhythm. <short pause> You simply receive. <short pause> Breathe in slowly... filling your lungs with God's provision. <short pause> Breathe out... releasing the day.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Your breath connects you to the One who formed you. <short pause> It is ordinary, and miraculous, at once. <short pause> Let yourself breathe a little slower now. <short pause> There is no hurry. There is nowhere else to be. <short pause> With each breath... you are held in God's care.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice

parts.text: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life. <short pause> Job, chapter thirty-three, verse four. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The same Spirit that gives life... remains with you now. <short pause> As you breathe tonight, you are sustained by the breath of God. <short pause> Let your breathing be your prayer. <short pause> No words are needed. <short pause> Just this gentle receiving... again, and again.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Rest in the presence of the One who breathed life into you... and keeps you still.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: May you sleep in peace... held by the God who gives every breath.
